title: Implement Cursor IDE discovery across both index schemas
description:
Implement discovery over ~/Library/Application Support/Cursor/User: globalStorage/state.vscdb (composerData and bubbleId keys in cursorDiskKV) plus workspaceStorage/<hash>/state.vscdb with workspace.json folder URIs for attribution. Union the Cursor 2.x per-workspace composer.composerData allComposers index, the 3.0+ central composer.composerHeaders index (with workspaceIdentifier), selectedComposerIds/lastFocusedComposerIds, and composerChatViewPane tab keys — the 3.0 migration is one-way and the central index misses old chats not re-opened since migration. Exclude subagent composers (task-tool style prefixed ids — verify on a real Mac). Open databases read-only with WAL present (never read state.vscdb without its -wal sidecar) and a busy timeout, with copy-then-read fallback while Cursor runs.

Done when: discovery returns the same composer set from 2.x-shaped and 3.x-shaped fixture pairs, attributes project paths, and reads safely while a writer holds the DB.
